clues.text: A devout, God-fearing centurion of the Italian Regiment named Cornelius lived in this city.
Peter traveled here from Joppa and found Cornelius waiting with his relatives and close friends.
When Grecian Jews in Jerusalem tried to kill Saul, the brothers brought him down here and sent him to Tarsus.
Paul stayed in this city at the home of Philip the evangelist, whose four unmarried daughters prophesied.
Roman soldiers moved Paul out of Jerusalem by night, and horsemen delivered him here to Governor Felix.
Standing before Festus at the judgment seat here, Paul refused a trial in Jerusalem and appealed to the emperor.
King Agrippa and Bernice came down to this city to pay their respects to the governor Festus.
